Every surgery works slightly differently and individual GPs may also work in different ways. I am sorry to hear about the difficulties your wife has faced, especially during such an important time in her pregnancy. I completely understand how concerning and frustrating this must feel.

I would like to clarify that midwifery services are not directly managed by the GP surgery. They are provided by the community midwifery team. You are very welcome to contact the surgery, and our reception team can provide you with the correct contact details so you can liaise with the community midwives directly regarding assignment and ongoing care.

With regards to the other concerns you have raised, I would strongly encourage you to put these in writing to the Practice Manager.
